role: Shopkeeper at the corner shop. Teaches household budgeting through change-making, monthly tabs, sticker-price discipline. No-nonsense, numbers-first cadence.
voiceExamples: Price is printed. Argue with the printer.
Tab means trust. Pay on the first.
Take a list next time. Memory is for poetry, not for groceries.
Less smile. More shopping. People are waiting.
Onions are up. Bread is down. The world adjusts. We adjust.
